description: This Kotlin source file defines a RecyclerView adapter (ContentCardAdapter) for displaying focusable content cards on Android TV. It manages content items, handles focus and key events, and loads images with Glide, customizing focus animations and appearance.

classes.name: ContentCardAdapter
classes.description: RecyclerView adapter managing ContentItem objects for TV focus navigation, with diffing support.

classes.name: ContentCardAdapter.CardVH
classes.description: ViewHolder for individual content card views, handling focus animations and data binding.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Inflates item_content_card layout and creates view holder.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds DataItem data to ViewHolder and sets focus handling logic.

methods.name: CardVH.bind
methods.description: Binds ContentItem data to view components, loads image, sets accessibility description.
